Version: 0.2.4
Section: admin
Priority: optional
Architecture: amd64
Maintainer: NQ contributors
Depends: libc6, python3 (>= 3.8), adduser
Conflicts: nq
Description: local-first operational evidence service

packages.package_control:
Package: constellation-nightshift
Version: 0.1.0+spine.20261004.1
Section: admin
Priority: optional
Architecture: amd64
Maintainer: Constellation contributors
Depends: libc6, adduser
Recommends: nq-ng
Description: Nightshift recurrence, applicability and observation-cycle runtime
 Installs the nightshift and nightshift-observation-resolver executables, the
 canonical observation-cycle unit and timer, and the site environment example.
 Installation creates the nightshift account and layout only; the site
 environment file, cycle request, timer enablement and start are explicit
 operator steps. The packaged unit differs from deploy/systemd only in the
 executable path (/usr/bin instead of /usr/local/bin).

packages.package_control:
Package: linear-accountant-inference
Version: 0.1.0+spine.20261004.1
Section: admin
Priority: optional
Architecture: amd64
Maintainer: Constellation contributors
Depends: libc6
Description: Linear Accountant durable inference accounting (la_inference)
 Durable episode and invocation accounting for the Constellation remediation
 consumer's model decider: owner-enrolled finite stock, per-episode
 reservations, per-call send fences and settlements without refunds, and a
 read-only reconcile. Installation is inert: it creates the root-only store
 directory and installs no enrollment, admission file or credential.

Package: constellation-attention
Version: 0.1.0+spine.20261004.1
Section: admin
Priority: optional
Architecture: amd64
Maintainer: Constellation contributors
Depends: libc6, nq-ng (>= 0.2.2)
Description: bounded operator-attention evaluator for Constellation
 Evaluates a closed registry of attention rules over qualified, current
 Constellation state once a minute and asks NQ to deliver notification
 intents (PagerDuty pages, Slack/Discord/local notices). Requires NQ 0.2.2
 or later (the response_class intent contract). Installation creates the
 state directory only; configuration, qualification and enabling the timer
 are explicit operator steps documented in
 /usr/share/doc/constellation-attention/README.md.
packages.role: selected reference runtime; explicit enrollment/activation required

packages.package_control:
Package: constellation-remediation
Version: 0.1.0+spine.20261004.1
Section: admin
Priority: optional
Architecture: amd64
Maintainer: Constellation contributors
Depends: libc6, systemd, nq-ng (>= 0.2.3), constellation-attention, agent-governor-ng-operator-tools, agent-governor-ng-systemd-executor, constellation-docket
Description: Constellation bounded autonomous remediation consumer (v1)
 A deterministic oneshot consumer (30 s timer) that asks AG for one governed
 start of one owner-enrolled unit per attention condition episode, plus the
 NQ unit observation resolver AG pins for the precondition and the
 postcondition. Installation is inert: no configuration, enrollment, keys or
 grants; the timer is neither enabled nor started.
packages.role: selected reference runtime; explicit enrollment/activation required

packages.package_control:

Version: 0.1.0+spine.20261004.1
Section: admin
Priority: optional
Architecture: amd64
Maintainer: Constellation contributors
Depends: libc6, nq-ng (>= 0.2.0), adduser
Description: installed filesystem-capacity host-posture observation profile
 Runs the narrow constellation-host-posture composition over an installed
 NQ-ng watcher and publishes a read-only status projection. Also ships the
 exact NQ host-load-pressure support family (producer, receiver and the
 pulse-support-resolver Nightshift consults). Installation
 creates directories only; enrollment, qualification preparation, unit
 enablement and start are explicit operator steps documented in
 /usr/share/doc/constellation-host-posture/host-posture-runner.md.
packages.role: selected reference runtime; explicit enrollment/activation required
